3532-5078-7750-8176.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7750-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3280-4881-6909.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
3280-4881-6909.description:
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

147-2438-3905.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2438-3905.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4419-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-4419-4694-7306.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

2105-2815-3337.easyPrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
2105-2815-3337.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block at least one creature you control.
2105-2815-3337.description:
Activate Reflection of KIki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare Combat Celebrant token and, if needed, an additional creature an opponent cannot block as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
When you attack, the token Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When you deal combat damage, Professional Face-Breaker triggers, creating at least one Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Repeat.

4871-5626-6415-6495.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Wriggling Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Wriggling Grub.
When Wriggling Grub dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Wriggling Grub trigger, creating two 1/1 Worm creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
4871-5626-6415-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-5551-6495.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
1270-5551-6495.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat from step 4.
1270-5551-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-5663-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cayth.
When Cayth dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cayth enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5231-5542-6147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6147.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rilsa Rael from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Rilsa Rael enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Rilsa Rael.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Rilsa Rael token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Rilsa Rael token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Rilsa Rael trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6147.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

206-240-5231-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-6351-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2366-3967-4875-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3967-4875-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1651-2638-4482-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2638-4482-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2638-4482-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Ancient Greenwarden, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

3668-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. When it enters, it triggers, returning Flesh Duplicate from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Put Flesh Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Flesh Duplicate's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 2.

1077-2511-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-3967-6791.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-4785-6797.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2292-3305-3817.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1909-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1909-5929.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat.

3327-4613-5073-6461.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
3327-4613-5073-6461.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Tinder Wall's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1251-2105-3204-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1251-2105-3204-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

488-2895-3200-4708-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Dark Sphere or Urza's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-2895-3200-4708-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

3097-4210-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Pious Evangel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Pious Evangel triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Pious Evangel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.
3097-4210-5641.notes: This combo only produces infinite lifeloss if the Wayward Disciple face is on the battlefield (in which case the steps are also somewhat different).

141-5362.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-5362.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Quantum Misalignment
141-5362.description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Quantum Misalignment, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Quantum Misalignment, creating a token copy of Naru Meha that isn't legendary.
Repeat from step 3.

1543-2984-3263-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Ugin has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
1543-2984-3263-4312.description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Ugin.
Activate Ugin by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

841-2438-4544-5310.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-2438-4544-5310.description:
Play a land card, triggering Dúnedain Rangers and Bloodghast.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing Bloodghast to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodghast, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dúnedain Rangers and Bloodghast trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

628-793-1380-2018.description:
Activate Scorched Rusalka by paying {R} and sacrificing Jewel-Eyed Cobra.
Jewel-Eyed Cobra dies, triggering itself, it's undying ability and Luminous Broodmoth.
Resolve the first Jewel-Eyed Cobra trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Jewel-Eyed Cobra from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the second Jewel-Eyed Cobra trigger, failing to return it to the battlefield.
Resolve the Scorched Rusalka ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Scorched Rusalka by paying {R} and sacrificing Jewel-Eyed Cobra.
Jewel-Eyed Cobra dies, triggering itself and it's undying ability.
Resolve the first Jewel-Eyed Cobra trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the second Jewel-Eyed Cobra trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Scorched Rusalka ability from step 8, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Scorched Rusalka by paying {R} and sacrificing Jewel-Eyed Cobra.
Jewel-Eyed Cobra dies, triggering itself and Luminous Broodmoth.
Resolve the first Jewel-Eyed Cobra trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Jewel-Eyed Cobra from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
 Repeat from step 6.

1908-2011-4891.notablePrerequisites:
Najeela does not have summoning sickness.
You have cast at least one instant and/or sorcery this turn.
At least one opponent can not block and kill Najeela.
1908-2011-4891.description:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, Rionya triggers, creating at least two copies of Atsushi with haste.
Put all token copies of Atsushi you into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Atsushi token that died this way triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Declare Najeela as an attacker.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate five of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and getting an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

1636-3590-4481.notablePrerequisites:
Heavy Arbalest attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3590-4481.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Heavy Arbalest ability by tapping it, choosing any target.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)
